versions.subject: Merge PR #5475 from @swachchhanda000 - Add `Renamed Schtasks Execution`
versions.detection:
selection_cmd_operation:
    CommandLine|contains|windash:
        - ' /create '
        - ' /delete '
        - ' /query '
        - ' /change '
        - ' /run '
        - ' /end '
selection_cmd_flags:
    CommandLine|contains|windash:
        - ' /tn '
        - ' /tr '
        - ' /sc '
        - ' /st '
        - ' /ru '
        - ' /fo '
selection_pe:
    OriginalFileName: 'schtasks.exe'
filter_main_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'schtasks'
filter_main_img:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
condition: (all of selection_cmd_* and not filter_main_cmd) or (selection_pe and not filter_main_img)
versions.spl: (CommandLine="* -create *" OR CommandLine="* /create *" OR CommandLine="* –create *" OR CommandLine="* —create *" OR CommandLine="* ―create *" OR CommandLine="* -delete *" OR CommandLine="* /delete *" OR CommandLine="* –delete *" OR CommandLine="* —delete *" OR CommandLine="* ―delete *" OR CommandLine="* -query *" OR CommandLine="* /query *" OR CommandLine="* –query *" OR CommandLine="* —query *" OR CommandLine="* ―query *" OR CommandLine="* -change *" OR CommandLine="* /change *" OR CommandLine="* –change *" OR CommandLine="* —change *" OR CommandLine="* ―change *" OR CommandLine="* -run *" OR CommandLine="* /run *" OR CommandLine="* –run *" OR CommandLine="* —run *" OR CommandLine="* ―run *" OR CommandLine="* -end *" OR CommandLine="* /end *" OR CommandLine="* –end *" OR CommandLine="* —end *" OR CommandLine="* ―end *" CommandLine="* -tn *" OR CommandLine="* /tn *" OR CommandLine="* –tn *" OR CommandLine="* —tn *" OR CommandLine="* ―tn *" OR CommandLine="* -tr *" OR CommandLine="* /tr *" OR CommandLine="* –tr *" OR CommandLine="* —tr *" OR CommandLine="* ―tr *" OR CommandLine="* -sc *" OR CommandLine="* /sc *" OR CommandLine="* –sc *" OR CommandLine="* —sc *" OR CommandLine="* ―sc *" OR CommandLine="* -st *" OR CommandLine="* /st *" OR CommandLine="* –st *" OR CommandLine="* —st *" OR CommandLine="* ―st *" OR CommandLine="* -ru *" OR CommandLine="* /ru *" OR CommandLine="* –ru *" OR CommandLine="* —ru *" OR CommandLine="* ―ru *" OR CommandLine="* -fo *" OR CommandLine="* /fo *" OR CommandLine="* –fo *" OR CommandLine="* —fo *" OR CommandLine="* ―fo *" NOT CommandLine="*schtasks*") OR (OriginalFileName="schtasks.exe" NOT Image="*\\schtasks.exe")
